title: Prioritizing Iterations
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting prioritizing iterations to storyboard frame sequence with narration, signaling, and reader-action notes, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Rank issues by severity and reach against the learning goal, not by ease of fixing.
Treat accessibility barriers as non-negotiable even when they do not block the median learner.
Build a triage table that makes the ordering inspectable and arguable.
Defend an iteration plan by tracing each item's position to its effect on the goal.
